--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_factory_field_context.py
@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+import pickle
+
+import pytest
+
+import attr
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("slots", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("frozen", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("init", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("takes_self", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("converted", [False, True])
+def test_factory_receives_final_field(slots, frozen, init, takes_self, converted):
+    calls = []
+
+    def factory(*args):
+        field = args[-1]
+        assert field is attr.fields(C).value
+        assert field.metadata["transformed"] is True
+        assert len(args) == (2 if takes_self else 1)
+        if takes_self:
+            assert args[0].seed == 5
+        calls.append(args)
+        return "7"
+
+    def transform(cls, fields):
+        return [a.evolve(metadata={"transformed": True}) for a in fields]
+
+    @attr.s(slots=slots, frozen=frozen, field_transformer=transform)
+    class C:
+        seed = attr.ib(default=5)
+        value = attr.ib(
+            init=init,
+            default=attr.Factory(factory, takes_self=takes_self, takes_field=True),
+            converter=int if converted else None,
+        )
+
+    c = C()
+    assert c.value == (7 if converted else "7")
+    assert len(calls) == 1
+    if init:
+        supplied = C(value="9")
+        assert supplied.value == (9 if converted else "9")
+        assert len(calls) == 1
+
+
+def test_factory_state_and_legacy_repr():
+    old = attr.Factory(list)
+    assert repr(old) == "Factory(factory=<class 'list'>, takes_self=False)"
+    contextual = attr.Factory(list, takes_field=True)
+    assert contextual != old
+    loaded = pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(contextual))
+    assert loaded == contextual
+    assert loaded.takes_field is True
+    legacy = attr.Factory.__new__(attr.Factory)
+    legacy.__setstate__((list, True))
+    assert legacy.takes_self is True
+    assert legacy.takes_field is False
